document.title: Form PENS.E/2-A — Payment Instructions for a Disability Benefit

chunks.part: Form PENS.E/2-A — Payment Instructions for a Disability Benefit
chunks.heading: What form PENS.E/2-A is used for
chunks.text: Form PENS.E/2-A provides payment instructions for a disability benefit under article 33 of the UNJSPF Regulations, including the participant's mailing address and bank account details for payment.

chunks.part: Form PENS.E/2-A — Payment Instructions for a Disability Benefit
chunks.heading: Sections on form PENS.E/2-A
chunks.text: Section 1 - Participant information (UID, pension number, date of birth, name, mailing address, phone, personal email); Section 2 - Bank account information (payee name, bank name, account number/IBAN, bank ID code, currency, account type, bank address, intermediary/correspondent bank, additional bank account information, other information); Section 3 - Emergency contact; Section 4 - Acknowledgement and signature.

chunks.part: Form PENS.E/2-A — Payment Instructions for a Disability Benefit
chunks.heading: Default currency of payment
chunks.text: Unless otherwise indicated, the disability benefit payment will be made in United States dollars.

chunks.part: Form PENS.E/2-A — Payment Instructions for a Disability Benefit
chunks.heading: When to complete 'additional bank account information'
chunks.text: This section 10 (additional bank account information) should be completed if the participant's account is held at a financial institution such as a brokerage firm (individual retirement account), UNESCO USLS, AMFIE/AMFI, or UNSSCA.

chunks.part: Form PENS.E/2-A — Payment Instructions for a Disability Benefit
chunks.heading: Documents to enclose with form PENS.E/2-A
chunks.text: The participant must enclose a copy of a valid government-issued photo ID showing full name, date of birth, and scripted signature, plus a recently dated bank statement and/or bank document (or a voided cheque and required documents) showing all banking information.
